subject: Pilot scaling & trial credit request — LumenAI (post-demo)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@lumenai.com>, Alex Chen <alexc@lumenai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot scaling & trial credit request — LumenAI (post-demo)

Hi Sarah / Alex — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned:

Summary of call:
- LumenAI wants to run a 2-week pilot (internal POC) embedded into the mobile app’s chat flow.
- Expected pilot traffic: roughly 12–15M tokens over 14 days (avg ~0.9–1.1M tokens/day).
- Production target (post-pilot): ~80–120M tokens/month depending on uptake.
- Target unit economics you mentioned: ~$900 / 1M tokens (goal to keep infra + model cost within this range).

Open items we need to confirm (so we can size pricing & credits):
1) Confirm pilot dates you want to run and whether you need the pilot extended beyond 14 days.
2) Avg prompt+response token estimate per user session (you gave ballpark ~900 tokens; please confirm).
3) Any compliance requirements (SOC2 / data retention) that would affect a private pilot?
4) Procurement contact & timeline for a purchase order / SOW.

Proposal & credits:
- We can provision a dedicated pilot stack and issue trial credits to cover the 2-week burn. If you need an extension, we can approve an additional credit tranche after internal sign-off.
- To move forward quickly, please confirm the items above. I’ll also loop in our legal/procurement email if you share the contact.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm pilot start date and token assumptions by EOD Tue (Feb 17).
- I’ll prepare a short SOW and a DocuSign for the pilot; we can issue an initial credit package once we have the signed SOW.

Attachment: pilot-proposal-lumenai.pdf (summary + rough price bands)

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Sarah Park <sarah@lumenai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alexc@lumenai.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot scaling & trial credit request — LumenAI (post-demo)

Thanks Rishi — quick answers below. Appreciate the clear recap.

Pilot details:
- We’d like to start the pilot on Mon, Mar 1 and run 14 days initially. If the results look good, we’ll likely extend to 28 days.
- Token assumptions: avg 1,000 tokens/session (prompt + response). Expect ~1,000–1,200 sessions/day to start (so ~1.0–1.2M tokens/day; ~14–17M tokens over the 14-day pilot).
- Production estimate: if adoption scales, we anticipate 90–110M tokens/month.
- Pricing target: the product team is budgeting for ~$800–$1,000 / 1M tokens at scale; pilot is flexible but we want visibility into marginal unit economics.

Procurement & legal:
- Procurement contact: procurement@lumenai.com (CC’d). They will request a short SOW and a PO. Timeline: procurement generally needs 7–10 business days after we submit the SOW.

Can you issue credits to cover the 14-day pilot (approx 16M tokens) and confirm any limits on extension? Also, will the pilot use hosted Redwood or dedicated stack? We prefer a hosted run initially.

Thanks —
Sarah Park
Head of Product, LumenAI
sarah@lumenai.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: LumenAI pilot details & credit request — please approve

Monica / Dev — forwarding Sarah’s note. Key asks from LumenAI: 14-day pilot starting Mar 1, expected ~16M tokens burn, possible extension to 28 days. They’d like hosted infra and are asking for credits to cover the pilot (and possibility to extend).

Requesting approval for the following (quick rationale):
- Issue $18,000 in trial credits (covers ~20M tokens at a conservative rate; gives us buffer for overage during pilot).
- Allow a single automatic 14-day extension to the trial credits if they sign the SOW within 7 days of pilot end (to avoid churn while procurement finishes PO).
- Require signed SOW before additional credit tranches beyond the approved $18k.

Attachments: SOW-template.docx (editable) and pilot-proposal-lumenai.pdf

If approved I’ll confirm to Sarah and send a DocuSign SOW.

Thanks —
Rishi
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Rishi — I’m OK to approve an initial $18,000 credit package with the following guardrails:

- Credit cap: $18,000 (no further credits without a signed SOW / PO).
- Extension: one automatic 14-day extension is allowed, but only if the SOW is executed (DocuSign) within 7 calendar days of pilot end. If not executed, extension is void and charges revert to standard rates.
- Hosting: run pilot on hosted Redwood (we’ll provision a dedicated namespace for them).
- CS handoff: loop in the CS lead (cc them when you send the SOW) for onboarding and burn-rate monitoring.

Please confirm to the customer and attach the DocuSign link. I’m copying legal for awareness.
